messages:
Maya Chen: FYI — Sapphire AI (contact: Alex) just told me they want to bring two new teams live: QA automation and Search relevance. They expect ~3x token throughput on current embeddings + rerank flows over the next 4–6 weeks.
Alex Rivera: yep, that's right. QA will run nightly bulk evals (~10M tokens/day) and Search wants lower-latency rerank for customer queries. Looking at Dedicated or a committed plan.
Jon Patel: thanks for flagging. Renewal for their pilot seats is in 3 months — looks like an upsell opportunity but we should check capacity and any compliance asks.
Priya Kapoor: tagging infra — @Liam can we support a temporary dedicated pool for their pilot ramp? Suggest 4x T4s or 2x A10G equivalent; also recommend enabling KV prefix caching for rerank.
Liam O'Neill: I can provision a burst pool in the staging region. Need to confirm model selections and seq lengths. Alex, can you share sample payload sizes and concurrency?
Alex Rivera: sending sample shapes now — typical prompt 120 tokens, responses ~80 tokens; embedding dims 1536; rerank batch size per request 16. Concurrent users spiking to ~120 during tests.
Maya Chen: note for CS plan: schedule a 60-min enablement with their ML infra and app teams next week. Also capture eval PRs so Redwood Optimize can recommend quantization options.
Jon Patel: commercial note — propose a 6-month committed slot for Dedicated with an option to convert to Private if they need VPC. I'll draft an amendment.
Priya Kapoor: quick checklist: 1) capacity provisioned, 2) enable KV caching, 3) run perf eval on quantized candidate, 4) onboarding session + runbook. I'll own perf eval.
Alex Rivera: appreciated. Also asking about audit logs and KMS — we're in EU and need key management. Is that supported on Dedicated?
Liam O'Neill: yes, KMS integration is available for Dedicated; I'll include the security checklist in the kickoff invite.
Maya Chen: action items: Jon — commercial draft; Liam — provision burst pool + security checklist; Priya — perf eval & quant recs; Alex — share payload samples & invite attendees. I'll set the enablement slot. :calendar:
deploy-bot: Automated note: capacity request #CR-983 created and assigned to eng-infra. Link: https://redwood.internal/ops/CR-983
Jon Patel: perfect — let's sync tomorrow 10am PT. If growth goes as expected this could be a high-velocity expansion across product lines. :rocket:
